scope: Post hoc inference on the already queried supervised teacher states, not a new generalization set. Near-best means best among the queried finite-depth suffixes; unknown legal actions have no quality label. No environment step, repair oracle, finalization or new teacher query is performed.

interpretation.full_hit: Unknown chosen actions count as no observed-near-best hit, not evidence that their quality is poor.
interpretation.evidence_hit: Argmax restricted to queried evidence; separates ranking on known labels from probability allocated outside the queried subset.
interpretation.Q_gap: Only queried choices have an observed Q gap. Unknown quality is null, never filled with zero.
interpretation.weighting: Within each group, renormalize equal-scene/equal-route teacher weights. Combined split masses are 64:32, preserving equal scene mass.
interpretation.all_states: Includes roots at depth 2 and descendants at depth 1; root-only groups isolate a common depth.
interpretation.probabilities: Probabilities use all legal actions; evidence cross-entropy renormalizes only queried actions as during BC.

request.scope: Post hoc inference on the already queried supervised teacher states, not a new generalization set. Near-best means best among the queried finite-depth suffixes; unknown legal actions have no quality label. No environment step, repair oracle, finalization or new teacher query is performed.

timing_scope: Diagnostic loading plus inference; not deployment planning latency.
